action.name: Execute
action.command: /bin/sh -c '/usr/bin/python3 -I -c "import json,os,tempfile,time; d=\"/run/zt-events\"; os.path.isdir(d) and (lambda fd,p: (os.fchmod(fd,0o644), (lambda f: (json.dump({\"kind\":\"callback\",\"ts\":int(time.time())},f,separators=(\",\",\":\")), f.write(\"\\n\"), f.close()))(os.fdopen(fd,\"w\",encoding=\"utf-8\")), os.replace(p,d+\"/latest.json\")))(*tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=\".latest-\",dir=d))"; command -v notify-send >/dev/null 2>&1 && notify-send -u normal -t 6000 "zt: Host SSO Callback" "Localhost SSO callback enabled for 5 minutes." || true'
